question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"between"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options **"between"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The word** "between"** is frequently used to describe the interval of time, space, or differences between two things, such as people, places, or thoughts.
 
 
• **Example: **The only distance** between** you and your dream is your hard work.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 3)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the other prepositions also.

 
• **Along:** When mentioning another element that is also a part of a given action or circumstance, we use along with.

 
 
• **Example: ** I knew the truth all** along**.
 
 
 
• **Among: **When referring to something as a group or collectively.
 
 
• **Example: **She is the most beautiful **among** all her sisters.
 
 
 
• **Across: **Across refers to being on the other side of anything or moving from one side to the other of something with sides or boundaries, as a city, road, or river.
 
 
• **Example: **I saw him walking** across** the road yesterday.
